boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission, no-purchase ways to share art, trails, parks, and public space around Kettering University and Flint.

cards.title: See the Mott-Warsh Collection
cards.subtitle: A free gallery hang in downtown Flint
cards.notes: Meet at the Court Street entrance, explore the current exhibition together, and leave time to discuss a few works before closing.
cards.short_summary: Share a focused art outing centered on work by artists of the African diaspora.
cards.evidence_claim: MW Gallery is open to the general public, and admission is always free.
cards.access_notes: Open to the general public. The source lists Thursday–Friday 11 a.m.–6 p.m., Saturday 11 a.m.–5 p.m., and second Fridays until 9 p.m.

cards.title: Browse Buckham’s Exhibitions
cards.subtitle: An always-free artist-run gallery visit
cards.notes: Drop in with a friend, compare reactions to the current installations, and check the gallery’s closure notices before setting out.
cards.short_summary: Spend an hour with changing contemporary exhibitions in an accessible downtown gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Buckham Gallery states that admission is always free for everyone.
cards.access_notes: The visit page lists regular Wednesday–Saturday hours and notes temporary installation closures; verify the posted schedule before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Bluebell Beach & Flint River Bike Path
cards.title: Walk the Bluebell Beach Loop
cards.subtitle: A free lakeside walk and picnic hang
cards.notes: Bring water and a packed snack, circle the paved lakeside path together, then use the shaded tables without reserving a pavilion.
cards.short_summary: Pair a short paved loop beside Mott Lake with an unhurried outdoor catch-up.
cards.evidence_claim: Genesee County Parks lists free admission to Bluebell Beach and its seasonal Splash Pad.
cards.source_title: Bluebell Beach & Flint River Bike Path — Genesee County Parks
cards.access_notes: Park hours are 8 a.m. to sunset daily. The beach and Splash Pad are seasonal, open 8 a.m.–8 p.m., with no lifeguard on duty.

cards.title: Take a Flint River Trail Walk
cards.subtitle: A no-cost walk near Kettering and downtown
cards.notes: Choose a turnaround point before leaving, walk or roll as a group, and use the official trail information to stay on paved routes.
cards.short_summary: Turn the area’s main nonmotorized trail system into a flexible social walk or ride.
cards.evidence_claim: Genesee County Parks identifies Flint River Trail among the free-admission City of Flint park areas it maintains.
cards.source_title: Genesee County Parks Seasonal Employee Guide 2025
cards.access_notes: County parks and listed Flint park areas are open daily from 8 a.m. to sunset; use daylight hours and follow posted trail rules.

cards.title: Hike For-Mar’s Trails
cards.subtitle: A free woodland and arboretum outing
cards.notes: Pick a marked trail that suits the group, look for ponds and forest habitats, and leave pets at home because the preserve is pet-free.
cards.short_summary: Walk through wetlands, fields, forest, and arboretum collections without an entrance fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Genesee County Parks states that admission to For-Mar Nature Preserve & Arboretum is free.
cards.source_title: Genesee County Parks Seasonal Employee Guide 2025
cards.access_notes: Grounds are open daily from 8 a.m. to sunset; the guide lists the Visitor Center as open 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Follow current posted hours.

cards.title: Meet Up at Max Brandon Park
cards.subtitle: A free neighborhood-park reset
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or walking shoes, meet during daylight, and use the open park grounds for conversation or a relaxed group stroll.
cards.short_summary: Use a named City of Flint park for a simple outdoor meet-up that requires no purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: Genesee County Parks lists Max Brandon Park among Flint park areas with free admission.
cards.source_title: Genesee County Parks Seasonal Employee Guide 2025
cards.access_notes: The county guide states that listed park areas are open daily from 8 a.m. to sunset. Use maintained public areas and observe posted rules.

cards.title: Walk Through Riverbank Park
cards.subtitle: A free downtown riverfront hang
cards.notes: Start from a visible public entrance, follow the park paths with a friend, and make the riverfront landscape the focus of the outing.
cards.short_summary: Take a daylight walk through a named downtown park along the Flint River corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Genesee County Parks identifies Riverbank Park as a free-admission City of Flint park area.
cards.source_title: Genesee County Parks Seasonal Employee Guide 2025
cards.access_notes: The county guide gives daily park hours of 8 a.m. to sunset. Remain on open public paths and heed any restoration or closure signs.

cards.title: Visit the Vietnam Veteran’s Memorial
cards.subtitle: A free, reflective park stop
cards.notes: Visit quietly with a friend, read the memorial elements at an unhurried pace, and keep the gathering respectful of other visitors.
cards.short_summary: Share a contemplative daylight stop at a named public memorial in Flint’s park system.
cards.evidence_claim: Genesee County Parks lists the Vietnam Veteran’s Memorial among Flint park areas where admission is free.
cards.source_title: Genesee County Parks Seasonal Employee Guide 2025
cards.access_notes: The county guide states that the listed park areas are open daily from 8 a.m. to sunset; visit during daylight and respect memorial etiquette.

cards.title: Unplug at West Boulevard Park
cards.subtitle: A free green-space meet-up in Flint
cards.notes: Set a daylight meeting time, bring your own water, and use the public park for a conversational walk without adding a shopping stop.
cards.short_summary: Make a low-key outdoor gathering around a named public park rather than a purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: Genesee County Parks lists West Boulevard Park among the City of Flint park areas with free admission.
cards.source_title: Genesee County Parks Seasonal Employee Guide 2025
cards.access_notes: The county guide lists daily hours of 8 a.m. to sunset for park areas. Follow posted boundaries and any temporary maintenance notices.

cards.title: Gather in a Free Library Room
cards.subtitle: A cardholder-hosted study or conversation session
cards.notes: Ask a Flint library cardholder to reserve an eligible small or medium room, keep the meeting brief, and skip fee-triggering extras.
cards.short_summary: Turn an eligible library meeting room into a quiet group hang with no room charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The library says most room use is free, including eligible small and medium meeting rooms, though a library card is required.
cards.source_title: Room Use, Food and Beverages in the Library — Gloria Coles Flint Public Library
cards.access_notes: A library card is required to use or reserve a room. Avoid long meetings, special setups, equipment, or food arrangements that incur fees.
